definition.simple: The price difference between two contract months of the same futures market, or a position that buys one and sells the other.
definition.balanced: Calendar spread = later month − nearer month. [[rollover|Rolling]] a position trades this gap. Spread positions still carry risk, because the gap itself can move.

example: Fictional: next month 51.30 − near month 50.60 = 0.70 per unit.
